title: Mäkelä Conducts Mahler 9 — Chicago Symphony Orchestra
description: Klaus Mäkelä conducts the CSO in Mahler's Symphony No. 9, a program of about 1 hour 40 minutes, with a free preconcert conversation with Carl Grapentine 75 minutes before the performance.

title: Chicago Bears vs. New York Jets
description: The Bears host the New York Jets at Soldier Field with a noon kickoff; doors open at 10 AM and tickets are listed as on sale through Ticketmaster.

title: The Chicks: Taking The Long Way 20th Anniversary Tour
address: 50 E Ida B. Wells Dr, Chicago, IL 60605
description: The Chicks play their 2006 album Taking The Long Way in its entirety for the first time, then close each night with fan-favorite hits; doors open one hour before showtime.

title: Lincoln Square Ravenswood Apple Fest
venue: Lincoln Avenue between Lawrence and Sunnyside (Giddings Plaza)
description: The 39th annual apple festival on N. Lincoln Avenue with fresh apples and cider from Midwest farms, apple-inspired dishes, hard and non-alcoholic ciders, live music, DJs, an artisan marketplace and hands-on kids activities.
sourceName: Lincoln Square Ravenswood Chamber of Commerce

title: The Great Highwood Pumpkin Festival
description: 17th annual pumpkin festival with a full carnival, live music on two stages, pumpkin carving, character meet-and-greets, NASCAR-style micro racing, costume contests and the Great Pumpkin Wall Lighting Saturday at 7 PM; no entry fee.

title: Topdog/Underdog at Steppenwolf Theatre
description: Suzan-Lori Parks's Pulitzer-winning drama about two brothers, directed by Kenny Leon and starring ensemble members Glenn Davis and Namir Smallwood; about 2 hours 25 minutes with one intermission.

title: Lee Miller: Fearless at the Art Institute of Chicago
description: First comprehensive survey of Lee Miller's photographs in more than 25 years, with about 150 works spanning her career; on view August 29 to December 7, 2026 alongside Beyond Form: Abstraction at Midcentury (through Oct 19).

title: Boo! at the Zoo at Brookfield Zoo Chicago
description: Opening weekend of Halloween fun with trick-or-treating, costume parades at noon and 3 p.m. on weekends, pumpkin enrichment demos for the animals, dinosaur shows, crafts and s'mores roasting; runs Oct 3-25.

title: Dragon Days Fall Fantasy Festival
venue: Elm/Library Park and downtown Lake Geneva
address: 1000 Block of W Main St, Lake Geneva, WI 53147
priceLabel: $15 one-day / $20 two-day advance; kids 12 and under free
description: Lake Geneva celebrates its role as the birthplace of Dungeons & Dragons with a medieval-style Fantasy Faire, tours of D&D birthplace sites, gaming, children's story times and more.

title: Brewers vs. Padres, NLDS Game 1 and Game 2
description: The 103-win Brewers host the San Diego Padres in the first two games of the National League Division Series at American Family Field: Game 1 Saturday evening and Game 2 Sunday afternoon.

title: St. Benedict Parish Oktoberfest (60th Annual)
venue: St. Benedict Parish (school gym entrance / courtyard)
description: A neighborhood parish Oktoberfest in its 60th year, with Bavarian-style music, food and beverages, carnival rides and games in an enclosed courtyard; free entry.

title: Walking Plays: Wuthering Heights at The Morton Arboretum
venue: The Morton Arboretum (meets at Thornhill Shelter, Lot 21)
description: Professional actors perform Wuthering Heights outdoors as the audience walks about 1.5 miles through the autumn arboretum; roughly 90 minutes, no intermission, suited to ages 12 and up.

title: Dead Girl's Quinceañera at Goodman Theatre
description: World-premiere comedy thriller in which three best friends investigate their friend Maria's disappearance from her quinceañera; 90 minutes with no intermission, recommended for ages 12 and up.

title: Lincoln Park Zoo
time: Gates 8 AM, buildings 10 AM, closes 5 PM
description: Free-admission zoo open 365 days a year with more than 170 species including lions, giraffes, gorillas, penguins and otters across 49 acres.

title: Chicago Botanic Garden: Free Admission and Fall Bulb Sale
description: The garden is open 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. with free general admission, and the Fall Bulb Sale at Burnstein Hall runs through the weekend; fee-based classes such as forest bathing are also offered Saturday.

title: After the Age of Dinosaurs and Pokémon Fossil Museum at the Field Museum
address: 1400 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60605
description: Special exhibition After the Age of Dinosaurs runs through January 3, 2027 and the Pokémon Fossil Museum through April 11, 2027 (extra ticket), alongside SUE the T. rex and the permanent halls.

title: Worlds Beyond Earth Dome Show at Adler Planetarium
address: 1300 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60605
description: New dome show Worlds Beyond Earth flies viewers through Saturn's rings, over active volcanoes and toward buried oceans and the search for life on distant worlds, with the museum's space exhibitions and skyline views.

title: Anne Frank The Exhibition and Powering the Future at the Museum of Science and Industry
venue: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry
address: 5700 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60637
description: The museum features Anne Frank The Exhibition, the new Powering the Future energy exhibit with a giant slide, The Blue Paradox and the U-505 submarine.
sourceName: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry

title: Aquí en Chicago and Facing Freedom at the Chicago History Museum
description: On view are Aquí en Chicago, tracing Latino/a/e communities' cultural presence in the city (through Nov 8), Facing Freedom on freedom movements, and the Emmett Till trial exhibition.

title: Underwater Beauty at Shedd Aquarium
address: 1200 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60605
description: General admission includes the Underwater Beauty special exhibit and the seasonal Stingray Touch alongside the aquarium's galleries.

title: Chicago Children's Museum
description: Hands-on play and learning exhibits for children at Navy Pier; open 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. both days with advance tickets encouraged and last admission 60 minutes before close.

title: Soul of the Stone at Garfield Park Conservatory
address: 300 N Central Park Ave, Chicago, IL 60624
priceLabel: $10 adult / $5 youth; free for Chicago residents
description: Five large Shona stone sculptures from Zimbabwe are installed in the Sensory Garden beds among living plants; on view September 5 to November 30, with Thursday to Sunday hours of 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.

title: West Town Art Walk
venue: West Town neighborhood (starts at West Town Chamber of Commerce)
description: The 16th annual neighborhood-wide celebration of local artists, galleries, shops and restaurants, with free pedicab rides Saturday and Sunday 10 a.m.-6 p.m. and free public art and mural tours at 1 p.m. (RSVP required).
sourceName: Choose Chicago (links to West Town Chamber of Commerce)

title: All Seasons Orchard Fall Fun
description: Orchard open Aug 29 to Nov 1 with 30-plus fall activities including a corn maze, petting zoo, pony rides, apple cannon and ropes course, plus apple and pumpkin picking.

title: County Line Orchard Fall Weekends
time: Attractions 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Big Barn 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM
address: 200 S County Line Rd, Hobart, IN 46342
description: October weekends bring hourly Peter Pumpkin Eating Dino shows, free Barnyard Jams performances, U-bag and limited U-pick apples, and the Brat Barn, Sweet Shop and Kitchen Restaurant.

title: Chicago Stars FC vs. Denver Summit FC
address: Martin Stadium, Northwestern University campus, Evanston, IL
description: Chicago Stars FC host Denver Summit FC in a Week 27 National Women's Soccer League match at Martin Stadium in Evanston, broadcast on CBS Sports Network.

title: Bright Eyes
description: Bright Eyes play Metro with support from Lullaby for the Working Class; doors at 6:30 PM and show at 7:30 PM, tickets listed as available.

title: Emil Wakim live at Zanies Rosemont
description: Stand-up from Emil Wakim, the first Lebanese-American cast member of Saturday Night Live, in two shows (6:30 PM and 8:45 PM); two-item minimum, first-come seating.

title: Salty Mom Comedy Tour at Zanies Rosemont
description: Holly Ballantine and Amy Brown headline a filter-free comedy night about marriage, motherhood and chaos; doors at 5 PM, men welcome.

title: Brand New at Aragon Ballroom
description: Rock band Brand New play two consecutive nights at the 5,000-capacity Aragon Ballroom in Uptown, with an 8 PM listed start each night.

title: Ministry and Acid Bath with Windhand
description: Industrial metal pioneers Ministry share a heavy bill with Acid Bath and Windhand at The Salt Shed, listed with a 6:30 PM start and tickets available through Ticketmaster.

title: The Revivalists with Robert Randolph
description: Roots-rock and funk band The Revivalists play the outdoor Fairgrounds stage with Robert Randolph, presented by Jack Daniel's; dress for an October evening outside.

title: Logan Square Farmers Market
description: A Sunday market on Milwaukee Avenue with local growers and food vendors; the 2026 season runs May 10 through October 25.

title: Elton Rohn: Elton John Tribute
venue: McAninch Arts Center, College of DuPage
description: A tribute concert recreating an Elton John show with costumes, a live band and the hit catalog, in the MAC's 40th-anniversary season.

title: Cedarburg Oktoberfest
description: A free Bavarian festival in historic downtown Cedarburg with live music and dancing, a vendor market, German food, a Third Space Brewing biergarten and family activities.

title: Starved Rock Lodge Ghost Tours
description: Trolley ghost tours with a costumed guide to locally haunted destinations around Starved Rock, about 1.5 to 2 hours; reservations required and space is limited.

title: Starved Rock Historic Trolley Tour
description: A 90-minute guided trolley tour of the National Historic Landmark, with stops at the Lock and Dam, historic downtown Utica and the Starved Rock Visitor Center.

title: Play On! — Duke Ellington jazz musical inspired by Twelfth Night
description: A jazzy musical retelling of Twelfth Night set in 1930s Harlem, scored with Duke Ellington standards and a 15-member cast; run time 2 hr 30 min. Runs through Oct 18, directed by Sheldon Epps.

title: Museum of Contemporary Art Chicago: Slow Dance and Kenzi Shiokava exhibitions
description: Current exhibitions include the interactive group show Slow Dance (Sept 12, 2026–Mar 14, 2027), Kenzi Shiokava (through Jan 31, 2027), and Chicago Works: Mike Cloud. Open Sunday 10 AM to 5 PM; free for visitors under 18.

title: Reality Detox: The Improv Experience at The Second City
description: A high-energy night of improv from The Second City with a few sketch surprises, built fresh each night from audience suggestions. Performed in the e.t.c. Theater.

title: Flyway City exhibition at the Chicago Architecture Center
priceLabel: $15 adults; students $10; children 5 and under free
description: Flyway City, co-curated with Studio Gang, shows how building design can protect birds, with models, mock-ups, illustrations and interactive media (June 11, 2026–Jan 3, 2027). Also on view: Chicago's Living Habitat and the Chicago City Model Experience.
